# HomeCubbie

> HomeCubbie is a free home maintenance and records app for iPhone and Android, coming soon to both stores. It keeps the facts of a home: what is in it, what needs doing, and what is insured until when. It works offline, has no account, and shares only through a server your household runs.

The facts, as of 14 November 2026:

- Free: no price, no subscription, no advertising, and nothing to buy inside the app.
- No account: no sign-up, no sign-in, no password, no email address.
- Works with no signal. No network at all, unless your household shares, and then only to its own server.
- No analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising, no trackers.
- Every room and whether it's kept up; the Things in it, what needs doing, and what was done, by whom and for how much.
- A Policy has a term, an end date and what it cost last time, and HomeCubbie tells you before it runs out.
- Reminders are scheduled on the phone: upkeep on the day it falls due, with a nudge every third day while anything is late, and a Policy twice before its term ends.
- Every Thing lives in its Place, with its make, model and serial number, when it was bought and what it cost, its photos, receipt, manual and warranty, and every repair since.
- Every bill, premium and repair adds up, month by month and year by year.
- The House manual holds the facts with no date attached: the water shutoff, the breakers, who to call.
- Upkeep is suggested for each room from more than 250 common household tasks, each with a schedule and a time estimate. Nothing is added until you say so.
- Bills, serial plates and documents are read on the phone. Nothing is uploaded to be read.
- A weekly backup, kept on the phone, and a readable copy of the whole house that opens on any computer without HomeCubbie.
- Sharing is something a household chooses. It runs the small HomeCubbie server on a computer at home, and every phone joins it. Everything is encrypted on the phone before it travels, under a key the server never has.
- iPhone and iPad with iOS 16.4 or later. Android phones and tablets with Android 8.0 or later.
- Not yet in the App Store or Google Play.
